build_dataset_builder: build a tfds GeneratorBasedBuilder for controlled_noisy_web_labels with mini_imagenet_red or mini_imagenet_blue config
create_dataset_info: create dataset info with image, label, is_clean, and id features for controlled_noisy_web_labels
generate_validation_examples: generate validation examples from clean split file and ImageNet archive with resized 84x84 images
generate_noisy_examples: generate noisy training examples from split files with controlled noise levels from 0% to 80%
resize_image: resize image buffer to 84x84 resolution using OpenCV with JPEG encoding at quality 72
